title: editor_report
description: The code editor's short report for one director plan: what it cut, what it could not do and which neighbouring slots look alike. Written by scripts/director_editor.py next to edit.json; the director reads it before approving the cut.

shots.description: one row per plan shot, in the plan's order

in_s.description: start of the used window; null for a photo

out_s.description: end of the used window; null for a photo

length_s.description: total on-screen length of the shot, its pieces included

target_s.description: the length the plan asked for; compare with length_s to see which shots came out short

technique_done.description: the technique when it was done, else null

why_not.description: plain words when the technique was not done, else null

pieces.description: the cut pieces of a multi-piece technique, in timeline order

total_length_s.description: sum of the slots' on-screen lengths

target_length_s.description: the plan brief's target duration; null when it has none

could_not_do.description: one plain sentence per thing the editor could not do

similar_neighbours.description: consecutive video-slot pairs whose window similarity reaches the threshold

summary.description: one short factual sentence the director reads: counts and numbers only
